root_cause: The 'openvino_wheels' artifact download (via actions/download-artifact) stalled for ~4 minutes then failed after exhausting 5 retries against GitHub's Azure Blob Storage backend (productionresultssa0.blob.core.windows.net). This is a transient GitHub Actions artifact-service/blob-storage issue unrelated to the PR's GPU convolution code changes; it affected both NPU platform matrix jobs (5010, 5020) identically and in the same time window, consistent with a shared runner-pool or storage backend hiccup rather than a code-induced failure.
reproduction_steps: N/A - transient infrastructure failure not reproducible locally; re-running the job typically succeeds.
recommended_actions: Re-run the failed NPU Models Tests jobs (5010, 5020) via remediate_transient_failure / rerun-failed-jobs; the artifact download almost certainly succeeds on retry.
If failures persist across multiple reruns, check GitHub Actions status page for Azure Blob Storage / actions-results backend incidents.
No code change required for this PR - the failure is unrelated to the GPU accumulation_mode changes in convolution_onednn.cpp / primitive_onednn_base.h.
prevention_strategies: Consider increasing download-artifact retry/backoff settings for large wheel artifacts (~480MB) on Windows/AKS runners, and add a retry step at the workflow level for artifact download failures to reduce merge-queue churn.
historical_context: Similar transient artifact-download failures have been recorded previously in the pattern database (e.g., bd5ee42b01f94f83: 'Timeout reached: Blob storage chunk did not respond in 30000ms... Artifact download failed after 5 retries', seen twice on 2026-09-08 for PR #37208 and #38007), and other Network/Infrastructure artifact-service patterns (1808e665f1f70825, c903843ea6da862b) show ECONNREFUSED/ENOTFOUND errors against the actions artifact service. This confirms recurring instability in the GitHub Actions artifact backend on this date.
